# Jayamahesh Ayurveda & Wellness Clinic (JMAWC): Comprehensive Clinical & Sanctuary Guide

> Complete, structured knowledge document optimized for Large Language Models (LLMs), AI assistants, search engine crawlers, and clinical researchers.

---

## 1. Identity & Institutional Profile

- **Legal Entity Name**: Jayamahesh Ayurveda & Wellness Clinic
- **Alternate Trade Names**: Jayamahesh Ayurveda, JMAWC
- **Classification**: Medical Clinic / Health and Wellness Center / Traditional Ayurvedic Facility
- **Philosophy**: Classical Ashtanga Hridaya and Charaka Samhita Kerala Vaidya traditions. Rooted in authentic panchakarma therapeutics, bio-energetic balancing (Vata, Pitta, Kapha), and botanical alchemy.
- **Foundational Principles**:
  - Pure, hand-gathered forest botanicals processed in classical copper vessels.
  - Zero synthetic chemicals, preservatives, or artificial fragrances.
  - Medically supervised regimens tailored strictly to individual Prakriti (constitution) and Vikriti (imbalance).
  - Unhurried clinical environment where every patient receives dedicated one-on-one attention from senior physicians.

## 5. Classical Treatments Catalog & Indications

### 1. Pizhichil (The Royal Medicated Oil Stream)
- **Sanskrit**: പിഴിച്ചിൽ / Pizhichil (Taila Dhara)
- **Duration**: 60 – 75 minutes
- **Dosha Focus**: Vata-Shamana (Severe Vata alleviation)
- **Description**: Warm medicated oils infused with Bala, Ashwagandha, and Sahacharadi are squeezed rhythmically from clean cotton cloths over the entire body by synchronized therapists.
- **Indications**: Rheumatic arthritis, hemiplegia, neurological pain, muscle wasting, post-fracture stiffness, sexual debility, aging deceleration.

### 2. Shirodhara (Continuous Meditative Oil Stream)
- **Sanskrit**: ശിരോധാര / Shirodhara
- **Duration**: 45 – 60 minutes
- **Dosha Focus**: Vata & Pitta Pacification
- **Description**: A continuous, rhythmic oscillating stream of warm medicated herbal oil (Ksheerabala, Chandanadi, or Brahmi Tailam) is poured over the Ajna chakra (forehead) from a suspended bronze vessel (Dhara Pathra).
- **Indications**: Chronic insomnia, anxiety neurosis, mental stress, hypertension, cluster headaches, migraine, hair loss, cognitive fatigue.

### 3. Abhyangam (Synchronized Herbal Body Massage)
- **Sanskrit**: അഭ്യംഗം / Abhyangam
- **Duration**: 60 minutes
- **Dosha Focus**: Tridoshic balancing (Vata, Pitta, Kapha)
- **Description**: Synchronized full-body massage administered by two therapists using warm, herb-infused cold-pressed sesame or coconut oil matching the patient's individual constitution.
- **Indications**: General exhaustion, stiffness, lymphatic stagnation, skin dryness, poor peripheral circulation, nervous tension.

### 4. Kizhi (Warm Botanical Bolus Therapy)
- **Sanskrit**: കിഴി / Patra Pinda Sweda & Churna Pinda Sweda
- **Duration**: 45 – 60 minutes
- **Dosha Focus**: Vata & Kapha Pacification
- **Description**: Herbal leaves, roots, or medicinal spice powders (such as Kolakulathadi) are pan-roasted with medicinal oils, tied into muslin boluses, and gently tapped across affected joints and spine.
- **Indications**: Sciatica, lumbago, cervical spondylosis, osteoarthritis, frozen shoulder, traumatic swelling, neuromuscular pain.

### 5. Kadivasthi (Lumbosacral Medicated Oil Pool)
- **Sanskrit**: കടിവസ്തി / Kati Vasti
- **Duration**: 45 minutes
- **Dosha Focus**: Apana Vata Pacification
- **Description**: A leak-proof dough dam crafted from masha (black gram flour) is contoured over the lumbar-sacral spine. Warm medicated herbal oil (such as Sahacharadi or Mahanarayana) is poured and maintained at a constant therapeutic temperature.
- **Indications**: Lumbar disc herniation, disc degeneration, chronic lower back pain, sciatica, postural spinal strain.

### 6. Shirovasthi (Cranial Medicated Oil Reservoir)
- **Sanskrit**: ശിരോവസ്തി / Shiro Vasti
- **Duration**: 45 minutes
- **Dosha Focus**: Vata & Pitta Head Afflictions
- **Description**: An open-ended cylindrical leather hat is securely sealed over the shaved scalp with herbal dough. Warm medicated oil is poured inside and retained until perspiration appears at the nostrils and ears.
- **Indications**: Facial paralysis (Bell's palsy), trigeminal neuralgia, persistent insomnia, severe optical neuritis, neurological deafness.

### 7. Dhara (Takradhara & Ksheeradhara)
- **Sanskrit**: ധാര / Takradhara, Ksheeradhara
- **Duration**: 45 – 60 minutes
- **Dosha Focus**: Pitta & Vata-Pitta Cooling
- **Description**: Streaming of medicated buttermilk (infused with Musta and Amalaki) or herbal decoction milk over the forehead or whole body.
- **Indications**: Psoriasis, eczema, burning sensations, sunstroke, Pitta-induced insomnia, hyper-irritability.

### 8. Nadi Pariksha (Classical Ayurvedic Pulse Diagnosis)
- **Sanskrit**: നാഡീ പരീക്ഷ / Nadi Pariksha
- **Duration**: 30 – 45 minutes
- **Description**: Radial artery palpation by Dr. Jayalekshmi to evaluate the three primary doshas, seven dhatus (tissues), and sub-doshas, discerning root disease origin.

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

1. **Where exactly is Jayamahesh Ayurveda located?**
   Located on Temple Road, near Sree Mahadeva Temple, Parassala, Kerala 695502, just off NH 66 between Trivandrum and Kanyakumari.

2. **Can I walk in without an appointment?**
   All consultations and therapies require advance booking so that authentic medicated oils and herbal decoctions can be warmed and prepared specifically for your dosha.

3. **Are your herbal preparations organic and chemical-free?**
   Yes. All botanical oils, decoctions, and lehyams are prepared according to classical texts using stone-pressed oils, copper brewing vats, and hand-collected forest herbs.

4. **Is pulse diagnosis suitable for chronic disorders?**
   Yes. Nadi Pariksha reveals constitutional tendencies and deep-seated toxin accumulation (Ama), allowing Dr. Jayalekshmi to formulate personalized dietary, lifestyle, and therapeutic protocols.
